records.title: AttriStory: Fine-Grained Attribute Realization for Visual Storytelling with Diffusion Models

content.summary: AttriStory pairs a benchmark of 200 five-scene stories across 10 artistic styles with AttriLoss, an inference-time method for binding requested attributes to the correct objects. It refines latent codes to align attribute–object attention during early diffusion steps, integrating with SDXL, ConsiStory and StoryDiffusion without retraining.
content.contribution: Manogna Sreenivas, Rohit Kumar, Soma Biswas. Co-first authors: Manogna Sreenivas and Rohit Kumar

records.title: TACLE: Task and Class-aware Exemplar-free Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning

content.summary: TACLE learns new classes from few labels and current-task unlabeled data without retaining earlier examples. It combines task-adaptive pseudo-label selection, class-aware weighted losses and classifier alignment using labeled and confident pseudo-labeled data. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset100, including one-shot and imbalanced settings.
content.problem: Learn new classes with few labels and current-task unlabeled data without retaining previous-class examples.
